datasets.name: Landslide4Sense dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Landslide4Sense dataset [34]: The Landslide4Sense dataset is a dedicated resource curated by the International Institute of Artificial Intelligence, specifically designed to support research in landslide detection.

datasets.name: Bijie dataset
datasets.verbatim: Bijie dataset [35]: The Bijie dataset is composed of 770 carefully selected samples originating from Bijie County in Guizhou Province, China.

datasets.name: EORSSD dataset
datasets.verbatim: EORSSD dataset [36]: The EORSSD dataset proposed by Zhang et al. is an enhanced and more comprehensive extension of the ORSSD dataset.

methods.name: MCFI-Net (Multi-Scale Cross-Layer Feature Interaction Network)
methods.summary: MCFI-Net is an encoder-decoder architecture that integrates multi-level contextual and spatial information. It features a receptive field block (RFB) in skip connections to aggregate multi-scale information and a multi-branch dynamic convolution block (MDCB) for dynamic perception and multi-scale feature representation.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a novel multi-scale cross-layer feature interaction network, specifically designed for landslide segmentation in high-resolution remote sensing images.

availability.author_statement: "The Landslide4Sense, Bijie and EORSSD are public datasets, and their links are mentioned in the paper."

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense, Bijie, and EORSSD datasets are referenced as public datasets, but no direct links are provided in the paper. The custom MCFI-Net code is mentioned but no repository or persistent link is provided.
